faq.a: Faruk is associated with the Arabic form فَارُوق, whose core sense is faruk; one who distinguishes truth (turkish form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Faruk?
faq.a: Faruk is associated with Arabic. Faruk is the Turkish form of Arabic فَارُوق (Fārūq), meaning 'one who distinguishes truth from falsehood'.
Yes — the underlying form فَارُوق is Arabic.
Faruk can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Faruk should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Fārūq is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Faruk mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Faruk is rendered فاروق and carries the sense فاروق، جداکننده حق.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Faruk, faruk. Script forms are فاروق, فَارُوق, फ़ारूक़.
